case: Declared BLOB column decoding follows each row's runtime storage class
contract: A declared BLOB column containing TEXT is returned as Value::Text, while BLOB storage remains Value::Bytes.
A declared REAL column containing BLOB remains exact bytes, and a declared BOOLEAN column containing BLOB remains bytes.
TEXT values in INTEGER, DATE, TIME, and DATETIME affinity columns remain text rather than becoming NULL or an unrelated typed value.
Native SQLite typeof() results independently verify the stored runtime classes, including SQL NULL.

validation.clippy: rtk cargo clippy --offline --locked -p tablepro-driver-sqlite --all-targets -- -D warnings passed

remaining: This case adds a BLOB-affinity storage-class regression only; broader SQLite affinity combinations and B3 acceptance remain open.
